messages:
jess_support: FYI customer on Private (VPC + NLB -> HAProxy -> Istio) is getting intermittent 401s only for very long Authorization headers. Happens ~1/20 requests, no obvious auth server errors. Repro steps below.

mike_eng-infra: ugh, header fragmentation across TCP segments can bite us. Do we have tcpdump from the edge?

jess_support: attached short pcap snippet, and a simple repro curl: `curl -v --http1.1 -H \"Authorization: Bearer ${LONG_TOKEN}\" https://private.example.com/api/health` — if I send a ~9KB token it fails intermittently.

amit_eng-platform: can you paste the tcpdump hex for the failing request? specifically the TLS record boundaries and TCP seq gaps.

jess_support: here —
```
0000  16 03 01 00 2e 01 00 00 2a 03 03 ... (TLS record 1)
...
(following TCP segment contains the remainder of the header)
```
It looks like the Authorization header bytes are split across two TLS records and HAProxy/Envoy sometimes drop the second chunk when parsing headers.

ben_eng-runtime: Envoy/Istio has `max_request_headers_kb` and also a header-parsing path that expects complete contiguous headers after TLS termination. With L4 NLB + HAProxy in front, the TCP segmentization can differ per connection and cause brittle behavior.

mike_eng-infra: possible mitigation: 1) increase `max_request_headers_kb` via an EnvoyFilter (Envoy option `max_request_headers_kb`), 2) ensure HAProxy buffers the full request before forwarding (`http-buffer-request` / `tune.bufsize`), or 3) move to an ALB (L7) so LB normalizes HTTP.

jess_support: customer is on NLB for static IP reasons so ALB isn't an option. They said HAProxy config is fairly default: `option http-pretend-keepalive` and `tune.bufsize 16384`.

ben_eng-runtime: 16KB buffer maybe close to the token size. If HAProxy forwards a partial header to Envoy, Envoy treats the stream as malformed and returns 401 (or 400 then upstream auth handler returns 401). We should try bumping `tune.bufsize` and `tune.http.maxhdr` in HAProxy and also set `max_request_headers_kb` to 128 in Envoy as a test.

amit_eng-platform: agreed. Also check `proxy_protocol` settings — if PROXY proto is enabled but mis-configured, header offsets can shift. And confirm whether TLS termination happens at HAProxy or at Istio. Which side terminates?

jess_support: HAProxy is doing TLS termination (SNI passthrough disabled). Istio sees plain HTTP from HAProxy.

mike_eng-infra: then HAProxy must guarantee full HTTP/1.1 header assembly before forwarding. Try this quick repro we used: generate a long Authorization header and run `h1split` test that forces different segment sizes. If increasing `tune.bufsize` to 65536 fixes it, we know it's buffer fragmentation.

jess_support: I'll ask the customer to test `tune.bufsize 65536` and `max_request_headers_kb: 128` change on a canary.

deploy-bot: rolling config patch to customer-canary: HAProxy tune.bufsize=65536 (1/1 done), will monitor 10m.

ben_eng-runtime: if that doesn't fix it we can add an EnvoyFilter that defers header parsing until body start (hacky) or force TLS passthrough to Istio so Envoy handles TLS and reassembly consistently.

jess_support: thanks all — I'll update the ticket with results. :thumbsup:
